name: TM44
description: The user sleeps for 2 turns to restore health and status.

gifts.note: Just talk to him. The sleepy man in this house in Lilycove City gives you the Rest TM the first time you speak to him.

Beat the Mauville Gym Leader (Badge 3). After the battle you get TM Package 3 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and a Life Orb. If your Bag had no room for the Life Orb, talk to the Leader again.
